Nina R: Short follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about sequencing for API / Console / Optimize. Capturing clarifications and owners here.

Marco: Top-level: API reliability fixes (rate-limit window, streaming perf) aim for mid-May canary; Console v2 beta for selected orgs in June; Optimize soft pilot kicking off early July.

Jess: For streaming perf, what's the rollback plan if p99 spikes during canary?

Ops-Bot: Canary policy: auto-fallback to v1 route if p99 > 200ms for two consecutive 5-min windows.

Nina R: Good. Also note Console v2 will add scoped API keys + RBAC changes 1; DevEx to publish migration checklist.

DevEx: Will post checklist and a small migration shim repo by Thu EOD.

Marco: Optimize pilot: 3 customers, US-only, 3-week runs. Need eval sets from Product and two engs for instrumentation.

Jess: Adding test asks: seq2seq heavy-load tests + token-level cost histograms. Ops, can you enable expanded telemetry for pilot?

Ops-Bot: Pilot telemetry retention extended to 90 days on request. Email infra@ to enable.

Nina R: ACTIONS: DevEx (migration docs), Ops (canary thresholds + telemetry), Product (pilot evals). I'll schedule a 30-min go/no-go next Mon. Drop any outstanding Qs here. :calendar:
